text.introducao: The "Spin-Vault" is my main personal project, It's an online library of vinyl discs, where users can easily storage and organize their discs.
text.objetivo: After market research, we can observe what collectors have so many difficult for organize your colections because a size their, the Spin-Vault he was created for solve this problem, proving cloud storage and organization for this collections.
text.comentario-extra: I work in this project around 7 for 8 months, aways focus in development code maintaning the good pratices and a organized architecture, I would like give emphasis for back-end, that I developed using clean architecture even in Python microsservice implementation (data processing). This is a very intersting project, and added a much knowledge for my programming experience.

text.introducao: The project "Instalar" it was a freelance job I did for an electrical and industrial instalation company.
text.objetivo: It's pourpose is to a help promote the company, guide and assist potential new clients, and at same time, provide an overview of the service are offered.
text.comentario-extra: This is a relative simple project in compared to others I maked, but it serves as work experience, because is one of firsts freelance jobs what I really work.

text.introducao: The "Students-cool" was my Final Project in the technical curse of Analysis and Development of Systems in Senai of Santo André.
text.objetivo: This project was created with the aim of reducing food waste in Schools, we achieved this by developing an online interactive menu (for both PC and mobile), where the professionals responsible for distributing food could share the menu of the day, and the students could select exactly what they intended to eat. This allowed the professionals to calculate with precision the amount of food to prepare, in this way, reducing waste.
text.comentario-extra: This project marked a turning point of my development trajectory, here I learned so many things while challenging myself with a programming language known for this complexity and verbosiy (Java), so at this point I really started dedicating myself to learning programming.

text.introducao: The "Life Link" was one of semester-end projects in Technical Course of Analysis and Development Systems in SENAI (3º semester).
text.objetivo: We created the Life Link with the goal of facilitating the communication between students, we used the initial ideia of Facebook, and apearence of Twitter (actual X) as inspiration.
text.comentario-extra: When I developed this project, I didn't know about back-end programming yet, so the alternative I found to solve this problem was to using the Firebase for both authentication and the database, even if it wasn't a good choose for a production environment, was a good idea for an academic project.

text.introducao: "FloraTask" is an online to-do list created for facilitate the tasks organization using a tag system.
text.objetivo: I developed the FloraTask alone in 2024, and the main objective of this project was training the knowledge I acquired in my Java course, and trying implement some adtitional feactures what I learned, such as the token-based authentication and a more elaborated database.
text.comentario-extra: I believe what the main positive aspect of this project was the implementation of token-base authentication, something that I learned alone by wathing videos and reading online documentations, at this point I was already familiarized with the Java language.
